title: Realization of smooth real vector prebundles
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], $q\geq0$, and $F=\mathbf R^q$ with its Euclidean topology and norm. For each $x\in N$ let $V_x$ be a real vector space with a topology. A real vector prebundle on this family consists of a set of open subsets $U_i\subseteq N$, fibrewise linear bijections $e_i:\coprod_{x\in U_i}V_x\to U_i\times F$ over $U_i$, and a selected index $i(x)$ with $x\in U_{i(x)}$ for every $x$. Suppose the selected fibre map $V_x\to F$ is inducing, meaning its given topology is the pullback of the topology of $F$. For each ordered pair $i,j$ suppose a map $A_{ji}:N\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf R,\mathrm{cont}}(F)$ is specified, continuous on $U_i\cap U_j$, and satisfies $e_j e_i^{-1}(x,v)=(x,A_{ji}(x)v)$ there. Assume also that these maps $A_{ji}$ are smooth on $U_i\cap U_j$, as maps into the normed vector space of continuous linear endomorphisms. Equip $\coprod_{x\in N}V_x$ with the topology in which $O$ is open exactly when $e_i(O\cap\coprod_{x\in U_i}V_x)$ is open in $U_i\times F$ for every $i$. Then the $e_i$ are linear bundle trivializations for this topology, and they give a smooth real rank-$q$ vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle].
